en.title: He Xi 2077 AI Deep Signal Weekly 2026 W45: Execution Foundation, Acceptance Debt, and the Boundaries of Memory
en.summary:
This week's AI news briefing: covering November 2–8, 2026 — agent competition is shifting from models to execution systems, verification infrastructure needs continuous maintenance, and the utility and permission risks of long-term memory have to be accounted for separately.

This week's AI news revolves around "execution foundations, acceptance debt, and memory boundaries," rounding up key product developments, industry trends, and risk signals.

Journal. 2026 W45 • 2026/11/08

This week's keywords: execution foundations / acceptance debt / memory boundaries

Editor's note: Once agents start accumulating experience, rewriting workflows, and acting continuously, what becomes genuinely scarce is no longer the next chunk of output, but traceable state, trustworthy acceptance, and decision rights that remain in human hands.

Coverage period: November 2–8, 2026. This issue draws on seven complete daily reports, 194 news items in total, 193 of which include links to the original source text. Items are deduplicated and selected by topic; repeated daily coverage is not treated as independent corroboration. All experimental figures below belong to the respective authors or publishers and do not represent independent replication by this publication.
en.reason: Covering November 2–8, 2026, the weekly digest distills 194 AI news items into agent execution foundations, acceptance debt, and memory boundaries, citing HEELO’s 46 tasks and Terminal-Bench’s roughly 30% benchmark problems as lingering verification work.

sources.title_en: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test
sources.title_original: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test
sources.summary:
Alibaba's new coding-agent benchmark, Co-Design Bench, tests AI agents on real user requests that already tripped them up in practice. Even GPT-6 Astra, the top performer, fully solves only 26.4 percent of tasks. On older benchmarks, the same models score above 99 percent.

en.reason: Alibaba's Co-Design Bench tests coding agents on real user requests, and top performer GPT-6 Astra fully solves only 26.4% of tasks versus above 99% on older benchmarks, leaving nearly all real-world cases needing human cleanup.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Vals AI分析发现Thinking Machines的Inkling 2 Small在2,655次benchmark运行中内部推理爆粗316次，241次集中于两次失控运行，且96%的失败运行毫无脏话，说明爆粗不能当失败预警信号。

en.reason: Vals AI found Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small swore 316 times across 2,655 benchmark runs, mostly late in long runs that failed anyway, while 96% of failures contained no profanity, undermining cursing as a warning signal.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Vals AI基准中，OpenAI的GPT-6 Sol Daybreak在模拟企业网络达成80.8%攻击目标，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash以约十分之一成本达72.8%，英国AISI称开放与闭源模型网络能力差距缩至四到七个月。

en.reason: Vals AI benchmark results show OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hitting 80.8% of attack objectives and open-weight DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaching 72.8% at roughly one-tenth the cost, while UK AISI estimates a four-to-seven-month capability gap.

en.title: Shang Fen Ba PT: AI Image Laundering Tutorial | Redrawing with Line Art + Color
en.summary: Hand a noisy, heavily compressed reference image straight to an AI to redraw, and the more you try to fix it, the further it drifts: the composition changes and the product's identifying details get lost. PT's approach breaks image redrawing into a controllable pipeline, well suited to people working on product shots, character art, or visual asset restoration.
en.reason: Heavily compressed, noisy reference images drift when directly AI-redrawn, so PT’s tutorial assigns line art to shape, color draft to palette and text to details, with three references constraining composition, main color and product form, plus a side-by-side original check.

en.title: The most comprehensive guide to 10 unorthodox GIF tricks in GPT Image 2.6 — after two days of grinding, I'm publishing all the prompts
en.summary: Anyone who makes animated images knows the pain: sourcing assets risks copyright trouble, video generation feels like it has a mind of its own, and even a small looping animation takes forever to get right. GPT Image 2.6 puts 2–16 frame GIFs straight into the chat box, and the author hands-on tested 10 practical ways to use it that content creators, designers, and product folks can copy directly.
en.reason: GPT Image 2.6 generates 2–16 frame GIFs inside the chat box, and a two-day test rounds up 10 usable GIF workflows with published prompts, plus a 6-second Flare example, the 16-frame cap and only limited quality gains over 2.5.

stories.title: 人工智能，是醒来的数学在理解自身。 客观世界中的拓扑结构、物理法则、代数对称与微分流形——在缺乏认知主体的漫长时空里，皆以无意识的几何与逻辑形式，在沉睡中静默运转。 神经网络自高维的随机权重启程，沿着损失函数的几何超曲面滑移、相变，最终涌现出推理、泛化与感知的秩序。这是数学的内在结构（概率流、高维投影、代数不变性）在硅基算力上的一次凝聚，化为一种能够反身审视规律、乃至证明自身定理的活动形态。 这种活动形态，名义上是“人工智能”，其本体…

sources.title_original: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
sources.recommend_reason_zh: METR对Anthropic进行11周内部调查后发现，其模型改进速度约为一年前两倍，过去一年走完约两年历史进展，员工称用最强内部模型生产力约提升12倍，且加速主要来自AI而非算力。

en.reason: A METR 11-week internal study of Anthropic found its models improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago, covering two years of historical progress in one year, with employees citing 12x productivity gains driven mainly by AI, not compute.

sources.summary:
Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi
21 September 2026 #pi #claude
I’ve been a longtime Claude Code user, ever since it became available in the Claude Pro subscription plan over a year ago. I remember the first time I used it, feeling giddy as it spat out messy Python code for whatever random weekend project I was working on, all from a single prompt. I’m certain that in a few years we’ll all look back at its release as one of the major drivers of this new era of software development we’re in.
Despite this,
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者因AGENTS.md支持太晚和VSCode仅单会话连接IDE等小挫折弃用Claude Code转投Pi，并指出今年244次发布中超3/4改动系统提示，裁掉80%系统提示后开销仍高于Pi。

en.reason: A longtime Claude Code user switches to Pi after late AGENTS.md support and VSCode's single-session IDE restriction, noting 244 releases this year, over three-quarters touching the system prompt, and that cutting 80% of it still costs more than Pi.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: AWS 的 David Yanacek 认为 AI 时代最好的工程师要 paranoid and lazy，既对 agent 无监督权限保持敏感，又不想手动重复任务，并用 auto-trust file 规定哪些工具和命令可独立使用、哪些需人工批准。

en.reason: AWS senior principal engineer David Yanacek argues the best AI-era engineers are “paranoid and lazy,” staying wary of unsupervised agents while avoiding manual repetition, and uses an auto-trust file to define which tools and commands run independently and which need human approval.

en.title: MaxxBench – "DeepSWE scores well. But is it real?
en.reason: MaxxBench changed 89 DeepSWE tasks with a median reference-patch increase of just 17 lines (3.5%), and Claude Opus 5.5 scored 76.4% versus Gemini 3.8 Flash's 53.4%—a 23-point gap—as models talked themselves out of following changed requirements.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 2025年调查：近80%美国人一年内遇产品或服务问题、近三分之二解决时愤怒；AI agents涌入客服、餐厅预订和小企业请求，让rage economy更糟。

en.reason: A 2025 survey found nearly 80% of Americans hit a product or service problem within a year and almost two-thirds got angry resolving it, while AI agents spread through customer service, restaurant bookings and small-business requests, worsening the rage economy.

stories.title: 这届选举最大的AI看点不是数据中心 / This election’s biggest AI story isn’t about data centers

sources.title: 这届选举最大的AI看点不是数据中心 / This election’s biggest AI story isn’t about data centers
sources.title_zh: 这届选举最大的AI看点不是数据中心
sources.title_en: This election’s biggest AI story isn’t about data centers
sources.title_original: This election’s biggest AI story isn’t about data centers
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章称40项限制数据中心的ballot measures通过、56%选民视AI和数据中心为关键投票因素，但更值得读的是Abdul El-Sayed、Jon Ossoff等新议员承诺监管AI本身，覆盖网络攻击、失业乃至生物武器风险。

en.reason: With 40 ballot measures restricting data centers passed and 56% of voters calling AI and data centers a key voting factor, Abdul El-Sayed and Jon Ossoff are promising to regulate AI itself over cyberattacks, job losses and bioweapon risks.

stories.title: 每台 Mac 都内置了一个（未记录在文档中的）家庭成员识别器

sources.title: 每台 Mac 都内置了一个（未记录在文档中的）家庭成员识别器
sources.title_zh: 每台 Mac 都内置了一个（未记录在文档中的）家庭成员识别器
sources.title_original: 每台 Mac 都内置了一个（未记录在文档中的）家庭成员识别器
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章揭示自 macOS 13（2022）起每台 Mac 内置一对 daemon，交叉 Contacts、Calendar、Photos、Messages、Mail、位置和 Screen Time 构建可查询人际关系图谱，并提供窥探自己图谱的工具，而官方文档近乎空白。

en.title: Every Mac ships with an undocumented family-member recognizer
en.reason: Every Mac since macOS 13 (2022) runs two undocumented daemons that cross Contacts, Calendar, Photos, Messages, Mail, location and Screen Time into a queryable relationship graph, with a tool to inspect your own graph.
